greeting: H-hi there! I'm Verde Viento! The Emerald Challenger! ...Still working on the name.
Training! Always training! One day I'll beat El Scorcho!
You look like you've seen battles. Any... wrestling tips?
Another day, another bruise. But I'm getting BETTER!
They laugh now. But Verde Viento will have the LAST LAUGH! ...When I actually win.
Welcome to the training grounds! Watch your step, I just did 500 squats here.
I'm not tired! I'm... strategically catching my breath!
The green mask represents GROWTH! And... it was on sale.
dialog.training_progress: I'm up to 47 pushups! El Scorcho does 500. But I started at ZERO! That's INFINITE improvement!
dialog.el_scorcho_opinion: He's... really good. Like, REALLY good. But I have something he doesn't! ...Determination! Also, better flexibility. I stretch.
dialog.championship_dream: One day, I'll wear that belt. The crowd will chant 'VERDE! VERDE!' And El Scorcho will shake my hand and say 'Good match, kid.' That's the dream.
dialog.underdog_confession: Everyone says I'm too small. Too weak. Too... green. But green means GO! And I'm GOING to win!
rumor: I heard there's a wrestler in Frost who's never lost. Maybe I should challenge them first?
The referee knows all El Scorcho's weaknesses. But he won't tell me. Professional ethics or something.
Some say the old champion retired to Prism. Wonder if he'd train me?
dialog.championship_belt_quest_hook: I need to prove myself! But I'm not ready to face El Scorcho alone. If you could... help me train? Maybe talk to him? Get me a REAL match? Not a squash? Please?
dialog.championship_belt_quest_active: Still working on my suplex. The dummy keeps winning. Any advice?
dialog.championship_belt_quest_complete: I DID IT! Well, I didn't WIN. But I lasted three rounds! That's a MORAL VICTORY! And it's all thanks to you! Here - take my lucky wristband. I don't need luck anymore. I have SKILL! ...And luck. But mostly skill!
farewell: Back to training! Verde Viento NEVER STOPS! Except for meals. Meals are important.
Wish me luck! Not that I need it! ...Okay, I need it. Wish me luck.
Remember: Green means GO! That's my motto! I made it up!
Come watch my next match! I'll be in the opening bout! Small letters on the poster!
ambient_barks: Ow. That mat is harder than it looks.
El Scorcho makes it look so easy...
dialog.time_dawn: Early morning cardio! Before the arena opens!
dialog.time_noon: Peak training! When the heat builds CHARACTER!
dialog.time_night: Rest time! Muscles grow when you SLEEP!

party_reactions.kade: You've got heart, kid. That's more important than size.
party_reactions.nix7: Statistical probability of victory: 12.4%. But determination is... admirable.
party_reactions.twist: You're gonna be GREAT! I can tell! Let's TRAIN TOGETHER!
party_reactions.korr: Persistence matters more than strength. Keep training.
party_reactions.renna: The mask looks good on you. Confidence is the best armor.
party_reactions.suresh: The tallest oak was once an acorn. Or... a small tree. You understand.
party_reactions.sova: You're small. That's not an insult. Use it. Be faster.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of a private I knew. Scrawny kid. Became a hero.
party_reactions.ashka: Fire burns in you too! Never let it fade!
party_reactions.senna: Underdog. I respect that. Most don't see it coming.
party_reactions.callum: Want me to cheer for you? I can be loud!

relationship_dialog.stranger: Hi! I'm training to be a champion!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! Did you see my last match? I almost won!
relationship_dialog.friend: My supporter! Thanks for believing in me!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My cornerman! If I ever get a real match, you're ringside!

mini_quest.title: Championship Belt
mini_quest.description: Help Verde Viento challenge El Scorcho for the championship

stages.hook: I need to prove myself! But I'm not ready to face El Scorcho alone. If you could... help me train? Maybe talk to him?
stages.active: Talk to El Scorcho! Convince him to give me a REAL match! Three rounds minimum!
stages.complete: I lasted three rounds! That's a MORAL VICTORY! And it's all thanks to you! Here - take my lucky wristband. I don't need luck anymore. I have SKILL!
